_comment: 20 raw-dictation fixtures for the Tier 1 bake-off. 'fillers' lists words that MUST be gone from the output; 'keep' lists terms that must survive exactly (mostly lowercase keys from the bake-off, which lowercased replies, so not a guide to case). 'reference' is the Tier 0 text of the case, words unchanged, punctuated and capitalised as the default prompt asks, with the spellings of fixtures/dictionary/seed.json. In a reference, (,) after a word is an optional comma and (-‐‑) an optional hyphen of any of those kinds, {.;:} after a word means any one of those marks, and ~ before a word means its case is not scored. A hyphen or dash in a reply separates words, as the guard's does.
